report_name: Retailer Claire's Investigates Data Breach Claim by 'Dark Project' Group

threat_actors.name: Dark Project
threat_actors.description: A threat actor group that claimed responsibility for a major data breach at the retailer Claire's, alleging the exfiltration of 1.71 terabytes of data on October 12, 2026.

attack_patterns.name: Automated Exfiltration
attack_patterns.description: The Dark Project group claimed to have exfiltrated 1.71 TB of data, a volume which suggests the use of automated exfiltration techniques to transfer large volumes of data over time to avoid detection.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor group Dark Project claimed to have stolen 1.71 TB of data, which would have required accessing and collecting data from Claire's local systems, such as databases or file shares.

identities.name: Claire's
identities.description: A global retailer specializing in accessories for young people that is investigating a potential data breach claimed by the Dark Project hacking group.
